extensionDescription.message: Send a link to the desktop downloader through your selected Internet gateways.

popupHint.message: Send the current page or paste a file link.

setupHint.message: Keep the desktop application running and enable Chrome / Edge integration in its settings. Your current folder, gateways and site profile are used.

invalidUrl.message: Use an HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, FTPS, SFTP, WebDAV or magnet link without an embedded password.

invalidPort.message: Enter an API port between 1 and 65535.

enableIntegration.message: Enable Chrome / Edge integration in the desktop application.

openApplication.message: Open the MultiRoute desktop application and check its API port.

sent.message: Link sent to the desktop application. File selection may be requested there.
